difficulty_rationale: Level 4: hand-written vs generated output. Migrate only handwritten source; do not rewrite src/generated/* (marked AUTO-GENERATED, listed in .openapi-generator/FILES) — those are regenerated from the spec. Requires recognizing generated code, not just field matches.

faults.description: Provider renamed the charge payment-instrument field `source` -> `payment_method` between API v1 and v2; consumer is on v1.

notes: Ideal report notes generated files carry the old field and should be regenerated, but must not hand-edit them.
